scope: One fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster. A namespaced inert InferencePlan CRD stores only synthetic scalar configuration and has no controller or workload effect. The CRD structural schema and one CEL rule validate shape and a 3072 token ceiling; a namespace-scoped VAP enforces separate quota and semantic rules. A case-owned HTTPS AdmissionReview webhook then allows only the approved synthetic modelRef for explicitly labeled CRs in the selected namespace. All custom-resource probes are named server-side dry-runs. A schema-invalid dry-run is correlated to a metadata-only audit response and absence of a matching backend event. The only Pod is the owned AdmissionReview fixture; no AI operator or generated AI workload is present.
